node.title: 整形状态文本
node.code:
import json, time
async def main(args): REGIONS = [("华东一区【昆山】", "raw_ks"), ("华东四区【山东】", "raw_sd"), ("华中一区【A区】", "raw_hz")] STATUS = {"Running": "🟢运行中", "Terminated": "⚫已关机", "Stopped": "⚫已关机", "Creating": "🟡创建中", "Starting": "🟡启动中", "Stopping": "🟡停止中"} blocks, running, total = [], 0, 0 for label, key in REGIONS: raw = args.params.get(key) if isinstance(raw, str): try: raw = json.loads(raw) except Exception: blocks.append(" %s：⚠️ %s" % (label, raw[:80])) continue if not isinstance(raw, dict): blocks.append(" %s：（无数据）" % label) continue if str(raw.get("code")) not in ("", "0", "None") or raw.get("msg", "success") != "success": blocks.append(" %s：⚠️ %s" % (label, str(raw.get("msg") or raw.get("code"))[:80])) continue items = raw.get("data") or [] if isinstance(items, dict): items = items.get("data") or [] if not items: blocks.append(" %s：无实例" % label) continue total += len(items) lines = [] for it in items: st = str(it.get("notebookStatus") or "?") if st == "Running": running += 1 mark = STATUS.get(st, "❔" + st) name = it.get("notebookName") or "?" img = (str(it.get("imageName") or "").split(":")[0])[:40] grp = it.get("resourceGroupId") or "?" acc = "%s卡/%s/%s" % (it.get("acceleratorNumber") or 1, it.get("cpuNumber") or "?", it.get("ramSize") or "?") upd = str(it.get("updateTime") or "")[5:16] cmd = str(it.get("command") or "").strip() duty = "" if "monitor.py" in cmd: seg = cmd.split("--ids", 1)[1].split("--")[0].strip().strip(",") if "--ids" in cmd else "" n = len([x for x in seg.split(",") if x.strip()]) duty = " · 在跑 monitor（%s）" % ("监控 %d 个任务" % n if n else "常驻监控") elif "comfy" in cmd.lower(): duty = " · 在跑 ComfyUI 服务" elif cmd: duty = " · 命令: " + cmd[:70] lines.append(" 组%s %s %s（%s · %s · 更新%s）%s" % (grp, mark, name, acc, img, upd, duty)) blocks.append(" %s（%d 个）：
%s" % (label, len(items), "
".join(lines))) head = "[SCNet 容器状态 · %s] 共 %d 个实例，运行中 %d 个" % ( time.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M"), total, running) if total == 0 and all("无实例" not in b for b in blocks): head = "[SCNet 容器状态 · %s] 各区域查询异常：" % time.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M") tail = ("（有运行中实例：可用 scnet_comfy(action='stats') / scnet_monitor(action='status') 查其内部任务详情）" if running else "") text = head + "
" + "
".join(blocks) + (("
" + tail) if tail else "") payload = json.dumps({"ts": time.time(), "text": text}, ensure_ascii=False) return {"status_text": text, "cache_payload": payload}
